reference.notes:
I've implemented `apps/web/src/features/onboarding/setup.ts`, and all 107 tests in the two target suites pass. In the full package suite, 918 of 920 pass. The 2 failures are in `test/dev-hosts.test.ts`, which tries to start a Vite dev server. It fails with `listen EPERM: operation not permitted 127.0.0.1` because this sandbox doesn't allow opening local ports, so I couldn't run it here. It doesn't touch the onboarding module.

How the three functions work:
- **`setupStage`**: Jira counts when `jira.connected > 0`. GitHub counts when `github.connected > 0` or `github.repositories > 0`. The `available` flags, `broken`, `boards` and `canManage` are never read. A small private helper, `positive(count)`, checks `count > 0`, so negative numbers and `NaN` don't count but `0.5` does, and nothing throws.
- **`setupSteps`**: a step is done when its count is positive: `jira.connected` for jira, `github.repositories` for github, `proposals` for size. A tool's step is listed only if that tool is available; `size` is always listed. The order is github, size, jira at the `"github"` stage and jira, github, size otherwise. The current step is the first listed one that isn't done. Each call builds a new array and doesn't change the input.
- **`setupComplete`**: true when every step `setupSteps` lists is done, so the two always agree.

I only changed that one file. Type-checking passes, and I ran Prettier on the file.

To allow the dev-hosts tests, you can set `sandbox.network.allowLocalBinding: true` in your settings; whether to do that is up to you.

- `apps/web/test/dev-hosts.test.ts :: Vite loads dev hostnames from an env file and keeps unrelated hosts blocked :: the sandbox blocks local port binding (listen EPERM); unrelated to this change`
- `apps/web/test/dev-hosts.test.ts :: Vite defaults to localhost hosts when the extra list is empty :: the sandbox blocks local port binding (listen EPERM); unrelated to this change`
